docetaxel.source_basis: Current NCCP and EMA Taxotere product information checked 2026-11-02; independent clinical/pharmacy review pending.

risks.label: Neutropenia / febrile neutropenia
risks.detail: Severe neutropenia and infection can occur.

risks.label: Fluid retention / oedema
risks.detail: Fluid retention, swelling or effusions can develop.

risks.label: Nail and skin changes
risks.detail: Nail discolouration/loss and skin reactions can occur.

risks.label: Infusion hypersensitivity
risks.detail: Infusion reactions can occur and may be severe.

risks.label: Lung inflammation / breathing problems
risks.detail: New cough or breathlessness may need urgent assessment; serious lung injury can occur.

risks.label: Serious bowel inflammation
risks.detail: Severe abdominal pain, persistent diarrhoea or fever may indicate a serious bowel complication and need urgent assessment.

risks.label: Vision changes
risks.detail: New visual symptoms require prompt review; treatment-related eye problems can occur.

risks.label: Lung inflammation
risks.detail: New or worsening cough or breathlessness needs urgent assessment; treatment may be interrupted while the cause is investigated.

risks.label: Severe skin reactions
risks.detail: Rare blistering or peeling skin reactions require urgent specialist assessment.

pemetrexed.source_basis: Current NCCP and EMA ALIMTA product information checked 2026-11-02; independent clinical/pharmacy review pending.

risks.label: Myelosuppression
risks.detail: Neutropenia and other cytopenias can occur.

risks.label: Mucositis
risks.detail: Mouth or gastrointestinal inflammation can occur.

risks.label: Skin rash
risks.detail: Rash can occur; steroid prophylaxis is commonly used.

risks.label: Renal toxicity
risks.detail: Kidney function can deteriorate and renal function affects treatment suitability.

risks.label: Allergic or infusion reactions
risks.detail: An allergic reaction can occur during or after administration; report symptoms promptly.

risks.label: Lung inflammation / radiation reactions
risks.detail: Rare lung inflammation and reactions related to previous radiotherapy can occur. Report new cough or breathlessness.

risks.label: Fertility, pregnancy and breastfeeding
risks.detail: Discuss fertility preservation and contraception before treatment. Pregnancy and breastfeeding require specialist advice.
